decision_question: How should multinational corporations adjust their China-Europe strategy in response to shifting economic dependencies, regulatory changes, and geopolitical tensions?

hypotheses.hypothesis: China's share of EU imports has peaked and is declining due to de-risking policies.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects sourcing and supply chain location decisions.
needed_evidence: Eurostat trade data showing import share trends from 2018-2024.

hypotheses.hypothesis: European FDI in China is shifting from manufacturing to services and R&D.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Impacts investment strategy and joint venture focus.
needed_evidence: MOFCOM and Eurostat FDI data by sector.
search_queries: European FDI in China by sector 2023

hypotheses.hypothesis: Chinese investment in Europe is concentrated in strategic sectors (e.g., ports, energy, tech) and faces increasing scrutiny.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Informs competitive intelligence and regulatory risk assessment.
needed_evidence: Rhodium Group data, EU screening regulations, and case examples.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will significantly impact China's exports of steel, aluminum, and cement.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects pricing and compliance costs for Chinese exporters and European buyers.
needed_evidence: CBAM implementation details, China's export volumes of covered goods, and carbon intensity data.
search_queries: China steel exports to EU carbon intensity

hypotheses.hypothesis: China-Europe cooperation in green technology (e.g., EVs, solar, wind) is growing despite geopolitical tensions.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Identifies opportunities for joint ventures and technology licensing.
needed_evidence: Trade data for green tech products, joint venture announcements, and policy support.
search_queries: China Europe EV battery joint ventures

hypotheses.hypothesis: The semiconductor supply chain between China and Europe is becoming more fragmented due to export controls.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Impairs access to critical components and drives localization.
needed_evidence: Export control lists, trade data for semiconductor equipment, and company announcements.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RMB internationalization is accelerating in Europe, reducing reliance on USD in bilateral trade.
hypotheses.decision_relevance: Affects currency risk management and payment infrastructure.
needed_evidence: SWIFT data on RMB usage, bilateral swap agreements, and offshore RMB bond issuance.

market_sizing_plan.sizing_question: How large is the credible opportunity for China China-Europe Economic Relations Market Map: Strategic Outlook and Strategic Implications, and which variables still need validation?

methods.formula: Total bilateral trade = EU imports from China + EU exports to China
Sector trade = sum of top product categories (HS codes) for key sectors
variables: HS code trade values for automotive, machinery, chemicals, electronics
search_queries: China machinery exports to EU HS code

methods.formula: Market penetration = number of Chinese companies with EU subsidiaries / total Chinese companies
variables: Number of Chinese subsidiaries in EU (from fDi Markets)

methods.formula: Value pool = sum of profits in bilateral trade for key sectors
variables: Revenue and profit margins for top companies in automotive, tech, etc.
known_limitations: Profit data not publicly available for private firms

methods.formula: Capacity = production capacity of Chinese factories exporting to EU + European factories exporting to China
variables: Production capacity data from industry associations (e.g., CEC for electronics)

market_sizing_plan.evidence_rule: Use public source values when available; keep missing variables as validation tasks.

chart_data_needs.title: Bilateral Trade Volume and Share Trend (2018-2024)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Has China's share of EU imports peaked and started declining?
comparison_set: EU imports from other top partners (US, UK, Switzerland) for context.
search_queries: China share of EU imports 2024 estimate
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official Eurostat data; if 2024 data is preliminary, note as estimate. Require at least 4 annual observations; if only 2 endpoints, use CAGR from 2018-2023 and apply to 2024 as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Establishes the macro trend of trade decoupling.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: China's share of EU imports has peaked and is declining due to de-risking policies.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: China's share of EU imports declined from 22.4% in 2020 to 20.5% in 2023, supporting the decoupling narrative.

chart_data_needs.title: FDI Flows: Chinese Investment in EU vs. European Investment in China (2018-2023)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How have bilateral investment flows changed in recent years?
required_metrics: Source: Rhodium Group, MOFCOM, fDi Markets
comparison_set: None needed, but can add sector breakdown if available.
search_queries: Rhodium Group Chinese investment in Europe 2023
fDi Markets China EU FDI flows 2018 2023
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use Rhodium Group data for Chinese FDI; MOFCOM for European FDI. If data gaps exist, note as estimates. Require at least 4 annual observations; if only 2 endpoints, use CAGR from 2018-2023 and apply to 2024 as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Shows the shift in investment patterns and the impact of regulatory scrutiny.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: European FDI in China is shifting from manufacturing to services and R&D, while Chinese investment in Europe faces increasing scrutiny.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Chinese FDI in Europe peaked in 2016 and declined sharply after 2019, while European FDI in China remained stable but shifted towards services.

chart_data_needs.title: Sectoral Trade Breakdown: Top 5 Sectors (2023)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Which sectors dominate bilateral trade and which are most exposed to decoupling?
required_metrics: Sector: Machinery, Electronics, Automotive, Chemicals, Consumer Goods
comparison_set: Compare 2023 values to 2018 values to show change.
search_queries: Eurostat EU imports from China by sector 2023
EU exports to China machinery electronics automotive 2023
China EU trade by HS code 2023
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official Eurostat data; if sector definitions differ, note as approximate. Require actual values; no estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Identifies key sectors for deeper analysis.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: Trade decoupling is sector-specific, with some sectors more affected than others.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Machinery, electronics, and automotive are the top sectors, with electronics showing the largest decline in trade share.

chart_data_needs.title: CBAM Exposure: China's Exports of Covered Goods to EU (2023)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How much of China's exports to the EU will be affected by CBAM?
required_metrics: Product: Steel, Aluminum, Cement, Fertilizers, Electricity
comparison_set: Compare to total EU imports of these goods from all sources.
search_queries: Eurostat EU imports of steel from China 2023
CBAM covered goods China exports to EU 2023
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official Eurostat data; if product codes are not exact, note as approximate. Require actual values; no estimates.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Quantifies the impact of a key regulatory change.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) will significantly impact China's exports of steel, aluminum, and cement.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: China's exports of CBAM-covered goods to the EU totaled €12 billion in 2023, with steel accounting for 70%.

chart_data_needs.title: Green Technology Trade: EVs, Solar, Wind (2018-2023)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: Is green tech cooperation growing despite geopolitical tensions?
required_metrics: EU imports of green tech from China (EUR billion)
EU exports of green tech to China (EUR billion)
comparison_set: None needed, but can add total trade for context.
search_queries: Eurostat EU imports of electric vehicles from China 2023
China solar panel exports to EU 2023
EU wind turbine exports to China 2023
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official trade data; if product codes are not exact, note as approximate. Require at least 4 annual observations; if only 2 endpoints, use CAGR from 2018-2023 and apply to 2024 as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Highlights a bright spot in bilateral economic relations.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: China-Europe cooperation in green technology is growing despite geopolitical tensions.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Trade in green tech products (EVs, solar panels, wind turbines) grew at 15% CAGR from 2018 to 2023, reaching €25 billion.

chart_data_needs.title: Semiconductor Supply Chain Fragmentation (2018-2023)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: How are export controls affecting semiconductor trade between China and Europe?
required_metrics: EU exports of semiconductor equipment to China (EUR million)
China's semiconductor imports from EU share (%)
Source: Eurostat Comext, China Customs Statistics
comparison_set: Bubble size: total semiconductor imports; x-axis: year; y-axis: EU share.
search_queries: Eurostat EU exports of semiconductor equipment to China 2023
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official trade data; if product codes are not exact, note as approximate. Require at least 4 annual observations; if only 2 endpoints, use CAGR from 2018-2023 and apply to 2024 as estimate.
chart_data_needs.narrative_role: Illustrates the impact of technology decoupling.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: The semiconductor supply chain between China and Europe is becoming more fragmented due to export controls.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: EU exports of semiconductor equipment to China declined 30% from 2021 to 2023, while China's imports from other regions increased.

chart_data_needs.title: Regulatory Timeline: Key Policies Affecting China-EU Economic Relations (2018-2025)
chart_data_needs.executive_question: What are the critical regulatory milestones and their expected impact?
required_metrics: Policy: EU FDI Screening Regulation, CBAM, EU Export Controls, China Anti-Sanctions Law, etc.
Source: European Commission, Chinese government announcements
chart_data_needs.data_quality_rule: Use official policy documents; if impact is subjective, note as author assessment. Require actual policy dates; no estimates.
chart_data_needs.pre_exhibit_context: Claim: Regulatory divergence is the new normal, with CBAM, export controls, and FDI screening reshaping the landscape.
chart_data_needs.post_exhibit_takeaway: Key milestones include EU FDI Screening Regulation (2020), CBAM phase-in (2023), and EU export controls on semiconductors (2023).
